docker.storage: overlayfs on an ext4 loop, because overlay-on-overlay returned EINVAL

missing_capability: Kernel AppArmor is not available. The active LSM list is capability,landlock,selinux, the command line sets nomodule, and /sys/module/apparmor does not exist. Docker therefore omits name=apparmor, while a container given apparmor=docker-default still has /proc/self/attr/current equal to kernel. internal/typedsandbox preflight refuses a daemon without name=apparmor.
observer_stop: spike/t454/native_acceptance.py observe exits docker length because GET /v1.47/info is Transfer-Encoding chunked and has no Content-Length. No deployment.json was written.
smallest_external_action: Boot this machine with a kernel that has AppArmor built in and selected in the LSM list, without nomodule blocking it. After that boot, GET /v1.47/info must include name=apparmor, and /proc/self/attr/current inside an apparmor=docker-default container must be the docker-default profile. Do not spoof /sys/module/apparmor. The chunked info response still needs the existing observer to accept a bounded chunked body before a deployment can be sealed.
